rows.ja: 気持ち悪くなっちゃう
rows.line: ちょっと目の前真っ暗になるし……気持ち悪くなっちゃう。
rows.en1: It makes me feel sick.
rows.en2: I'd get all queasy.

rows.line: 罰としてやったなぁ。蹴られ損だからさ。
rows.en1: He just took that kick for nothing.
rows.en2: That's a free shot, and he gets nothing for it.

rows.line: KOも見れたしね。本当にすごい満足だったなぁ。
rows.en1: I was totally satisfied.
rows.en2: Honestly, it was so worth it.

rows.line: 結構興奮しちゃったんだな。
rows.en1: I got pretty fired up.
rows.en2: I got way more into it than I expected.

rows.line: ちょっとできれば日本語がいいなーっていう。
rows.en1: I'd rather have it in Japanese if I could.
rows.en2: Ideally, it'd be in Japanese.

rows.line: 悔しい思いした人いっぱいいるんじゃないかなぁ。
rows.en1: I bet a lot of people were bummed.
rows.en2: Tons of people must've been gutted.

rows.line: 思った以上にさ、その客の人が声出してるね。
rows.en1: The crowd was way louder than I expected.
rows.en2: People were yelling a lot more than I thought.

rows.line: もう左ハイキックしか言わない人がいて。
rows.en1: All he'd yell was 'left high kick.'
rows.en2: The guy just kept yelling the same thing.

rows.line: 初めてだからわからなかったけど、良いのか悪いのか。
rows.en1: Not sure if that's a good thing or not.
rows.en2: Good or bad, I couldn't tell you.

rows.line: やっぱその選手を知ってるからこそなのか。
rows.en1: Maybe it's because he knows the guy.
rows.en2: Probably because he's a fan.

rows.line: ヤジで絶対聞こえてるね、あんなに。
rows.en1: They can definitely hear that.
rows.en2: No way they can't hear it.

rows.ja: テレビで見てるとわかんないけど
rows.line: テレビで見てるとわかんないけど、観客の声ってわりと聞こえる。
rows.en1: You don't get that watching on TV.
rows.en2: TV doesn't really show you that.

rows.line: あれは多分テレビ見てたら絶対伝わらない。
rows.en1: That totally doesn't come across on TV.
rows.en2: You'd never get that from TV.

rows.line: もう1回ぐらい行っときゃよかったなと思った。
rows.en1: I should've gone at least once more.
rows.en2: Wish I'd gone one more time.

rows.ja: もったいないことした
rows.line: ほんと見ておきたかった。もったいないことした。
rows.en1: I really missed out.
rows.en2: What a waste.

rows.line: 惜しかったな。そうだね。
rows.en1: That's a real shame.
rows.en2: Man, so close.

rows.line: 何て名前だかもう忘れちゃった。
rows.en1: I forgot what it was called.
rows.en2: The name totally slipped my mind.

rows.line: ほんといい、なかなかない機会というか。
rows.en1: It's not something you get to do every day.
rows.en2: It's a pretty rare chance.

rows.line: また機会があったらね。
rows.en1: If I ever get the chance again.
rows.en2: Next time I get a shot.

rows.line: 24歳の時夢などありましたか。答えていただけたら幸いです。
rows.en1: I'd really appreciate it if you answered.
rows.en2: It'd mean a lot if you could answer.

rows.ja: どうにかなんじゃねーの
rows.line: もしかしたら俺どうにかなんじゃねーのっていう。
rows.en1: Maybe it'll all work out somehow.
rows.en2: I'll figure it out, probably.

rows.line: どうにかなんじゃねーのっていう淡い期待を感じている時。
rows.en1: a little glimmer of hope
rows.en2: kind of hoping, you know

rows.line: ちょっとクソみてえな生活してるけど。
rows.en1: My life's kind of a mess, but...
rows.en2: I'm living like crap right now, but...

rows.line: 大学行って就職とかだと、まあまあ考える余裕もない。
rows.en1: no time to even think about it
rows.en2: too busy to even think

rows.ja: 〜じゃなくていいんじゃない
rows.line: 何かになりたいとかじゃなくていいんじゃないかと思う。
rows.en1: It doesn't have to be some big thing.
rows.en2: You don't need to become something.

rows.line: なんか海外行きたいとかでもいいじゃんと思う。
rows.en1: Even just 'I want to travel' is fine.
rows.en2: Why not just, like, going abroad?

rows.line: なるほど、消去法だよね。
rows.en1: Just cross off what you don't want.
rows.en2: Process of elimination, basically.

rows.line: なるほどね。うん、結構かかりそうだけどね。
rows.en1: That might take a while, though.
rows.en2: Could take forever.

rows.ja: 全然いいんじゃねえかな
rows.line: 職業としての夢じゃなくて全然いいんじゃねえかなと思う。
rows.en1: That's totally fine.
rows.en2: Nothing wrong with that.

rows.ja: でっかく聞こえちゃう
rows.line: 夢っていうとちょっとでっかく聞こえちゃうから。
rows.en1: 'Dream' just sounds so huge.
rows.en2: It makes it sound like such a big deal.

rows.line: 周りが結構熱心に働き出して……焦りだすんだよね。
rows.en1: You start to panic.
rows.en2: You start freaking out a little.

rows.line: まあ気持ちはわかりますけども。
rows.en1: I get how you feel.
rows.en2: I know where you're coming from.

rows.line: だからまあしょうがないって。
rows.en1: Oh well, it is what it is.
rows.en2: Can't be helped.

rows.line: ちょっと蜘蛛は生かしておいている。
rows.en1: I'm letting them live.
rows.en2: I just leave them alone.
